== Title ==
<span lang="ja">下面からの攻撃</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに自分の戦士と同じ位置にいる装甲値を持ったビークルを目標とする。運命数を引く。戦士が「コンカッション・グレネード」かライトセーバーを持っているなら、運命数に3を加える（両方持っているなら7）。運命数の合計＞装甲値ならビークル（とグレネード）はロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍は資源が乏しく、人員も不足している。そのため、しばしば一か八かの戦法を取らざるを得ない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Under Attack.

'''Lore''' — The Rebellion is short of resources and personnel. It therefore often has no choice but to use all-or-nothing tactics.

'''Game text''' — During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor at the same location as one of your warriors. Draw destiny. If the warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber, add 3 to destiny (7 if both). The vehicle and grenade are lost if total destiny exceeds armor.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The title means “attack from below.” Lore uses all-or-nothing tactics for desperate strategies. Game text uses 位置 for site; grenade is quoted and lightsaber is not.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-underattack-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Under Attack]].</ref>
